newsitem.title: UK: Shell starting 20,000 bpd UK Gannet oilfields.
newsitem.headline: Shell starting 20,000 bpd UK Gannet oilfields.

text.p: Shell Expro's Gannet E British North Sea oilfield development is expected onstream in about three weeks, adding to the newly-commissioned Gannet F field, a Shell spokeswoman said on Wednesday.
Gannet E would pump 8,000 barrels a day (bpd) from its 23 million barrels of reserves from mid-August, the spokeswoman said.
Gannet F came onstream on June 23 and would soon reach capacity at 12,000 bpd from its 19 million-barrel reserves, she added.
The Gannet fields are linked to the predominantly Norwegian Ekofisk pipeline system which lands oil at Teeside in northeastern England.
Shell is expecting to begin output from three further U.K. North Sea fields -- Curlew, Kingfisher and Mallard -- in October.
Shell Expro operates in the North Sea on behalf of Royal Dutch/Shell and Exxon.
